lines: Baby inclines and bosu work. Inclines up to 2.5%.
**90 sec WR, get to base when ready**
**90 sec WR, get to base when ready**
**90 sec to transition to the floor**
* 8 x bosu single arm split squat (L)
* 8 x dumbbell single arm lateral lunge (L)
* 8 x half kneeling single arm hammer curl (L), rest
* 8 x bosu single arm split squat (R)
* 8 x dumbbell single arm lateral lunge (R)
* 8 x half kneeling single arm hammer curl (R), rest
* 8 each x bosu split leg crunch
**90 sec to transition to the rower**
* Goal: match or beat your distance on each all out row
* 30 sec AO row (20 - 24 strokes / minute), check & remember distance
* 30 sec AO row (20 - 24 strokes / minute), check & remember distance
* 30 sec AO row (20 - 24 strokes / minute), check distance
**90 sec to transition to the floor**
* 8 x bosu split stance single arm low row (front foot on bosu, L)
* 8 x single arm neutral grip reverse lunge (L)
* 8 x half kneeling single arm shoulder press (L), rest
* 8 x bosu split stance single arm low row (front foot on bosu, R)
* 8 x single arm neutral grip reverse lunge (R)
* 8 x half kneeling single arm shoulder press (R), rest
* Repeat until time for **finisher**: 30 sec of bosu back extension
Not bad for a fake strength day template. I would still give today a 2 (🪶🪶) out of 5 for gentleness. !<
